name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix added +0.78% on Tuesday's KOSPI session, closing at ₩2,327,000 — a healthy consolidation after Monday's blistering +7.4% surge. This is exactly what disciplined bulls want to see: the KOSPI opened with confirmation of the US June 15 close (S&P +1.65% to 7,554, Dow at an ALL-TIME RECORD of 51,671, Nasdaq +3.07%), held the breakout gains, and printed a quiet follow-through session rather than a reversal. The stock now sits 3.3% below the ₩2,407,000 ATH (June 2). The fundamental anchor beneath the price action: NVIDIA's $25B bond sale ($85B in orders) and the locked-in SK Hynix multi-year memory partnership (June 8) — two data points that together say AI HBM demand is real, funded, and supply-contracted. FOMC June 17 remains the near-term ceiling; a dovish Warsh sends SK Hynix into price discovery above the ATH.

The only remaining gate is FOMC Wednesday: a dovish Warsh press conference sends the stock into price discovery above the ₩2,407,000 ATH. Sizing: hold core long, scale any incremental adds — after a +13.6% three-day run, the risk/reward of new adds is better on a post-FOMC pullback to ₩2,250,000–₩2,280,000 than chasing the close today.

analysis:
## Healthy consolidation after a historic session

SK Hynix printed **₩2,327,000** (+0.78%) on Tuesday, consolidating Monday's +7.4% surge in textbook fashion. The KOSPI opened with the full weight of the US June 15 close behind it — **S&P +1.65% to 7,554, Dow at an ALL-TIME RECORD 51,671, Nasdaq +3.07%** (best session since March 31) — and SK Hynix held its gains cleanly. Volume contracted to ~4.1M shares from Monday's ~7.18M, confirming that the flushing/flipping supply from the panic-sellers of early June has been absorbed. The residual holder base is structural-long.

## The NVIDIA bond sale is the HBM demand signal

[NVIDIA's $25 billion bond sale attracted $85 billion in orders](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-06-15/nvidia-kicks-off-first-high-grade-bond-offering-since-2021) — 3.4x oversubscribed, across seven tranches, with the 30Y tranche pricing at +65 bps over Treasuries. Read this alongside the [June 8 SK Hynix–NVIDIA multi-year technology partnership](https://news.skhynix.com/multi-year-tech-partnership-with-nvidia/) and the message is unambiguous: NVIDIA is funding the AI buildout with debt, not equity, with the conviction of a management team that has locked in its memory supply chain. [UBS estimates SK Hynix at ~70% HBM4 market share for the Rubin platform](https://thenextweb.com/news/nvidia-locks-in-sk-hynix-for-the-ai-memory-race-as-the-chip-industrys-toughest-bottleneck-gets-its-own-multi-year-deal). The supply is contracted. The demand is funded. The bottleneck the briefings have flagged all year is exactly where BofA says the 2026 HBM market is heading: $54.6B (+58% YoY).

## Within 3.3% of the ATH — but the gate is Warsh

At ₩2,327,000, SK Hynix is **3.3% below the ₩2,407,000 ATH** from June 2. That gap is one Warsh press conference from being erased. A non-hawkish Fed on June 17 — hold, neutral stance language, no hike signal — takes the stock into price discovery above the ATH with the full force of the AI-memory bull case as the anchor, including the [~38-analyst PT near ₩2.52M (+8.4%)](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/krx/000660/). A hawkish surprise provides a ₩2,250,000–₩2,280,000 add window — which would be a gift. Either outcome is constructive for patient longs.
